topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: Well, now, this be a queer turn, ain't it? Old Elwin, with his patched coat and reluctant smile, turns out to have pockets deeper than the village well. I always thought him scrappy, making do with what the meager earth would give. But gold? Swords to the sheathe, we've all been eyeing the drought and the tax man's visits with a wary heart. To think he's been dealing in silk when we're down to the nub of the reed. I've been mulling over the state of my own fields, the seed tight in the sack, wondering how the next harvest might ease the strain. But now, the thought of him hording wealth makes the sky feel a shade darker, the soil a touch harder. We'll need to see if the saints are listening this Compline. Mayhap they can guide our hearts to the right path, what with all this new light on old Elwin.
